hardware.variant: Assembled kit; V1.2 reported by operator; ESP32-S31 silicon revision 0.0 identified through ROM

inputs.name: NOR FIT sector image
inputs.revision: S31 firmware, kernel and memory-disk root FIT

inputs.name: Static FFS RAM root filesystem
inputs.revision: Modified OS worktree based on efe18759405516fc3925570e07d0094eabc7ad3a; source-worktree SHA256 5109cdc1237b3e64c1474c52dee421c2243b0068c9e5a42dc072a68d66b50c13; console producer published at 27242ccd8e397de27e50b57589d3d4c97e4ca5e1

scenario: Power the V1.2 kit from its battery with USB-C disconnected; press POWER without BOOT and observe the UART console. Exercise simple single-user shell commands.
expected: The ROM boots the installed NOR image and the kernel mounts its memory-disk root and provides an interactive single-user shell.
observed: One battery-powered POWER press produced a POWERON reset and SPI flash boot. SPL, OpenSBI and U-Boot started the ESP_MOSAICO kernel, which mounted an FFS root on md0a and reached a single-user shell. Shell input and output, a child shell, /tmp and a read of hello were observed. After USB-C was connected, pwd still reported /tmp and the same console accepted a command and printed its expected output.
limits: This is one battery-powered normal POWER-on boot on one operator-reported V1.2 sample; it does not establish sustained reliability or repeated power cycles.
Connecting USB-C to the already running system did not test a power-on boot with USB-C attached.
The persistent NOR holds boot and root image inputs; the running FFS root is an in-memory disk, not a writable persistent filesystem.
This does not test NAND, full-range PSRAM read/write or general peripheral and application support.
A child shell and console input/output were observed; no new Ctrl-C or full POSIX, PTY and signal tests were performed in this boot.
FIT SHA-256 checks integrity and does not establish authenticated firmware.
The UART logs and device identifiers remain private; no raw logs or identifiers are published.
